questions.answer: A GEO strategy needs a technical foundation first. Without it, AI systems may not be able to crawl your content, and discovered pages may not be indexed for AI retrieval [2]. Key pieces include making sure AI crawlers can reach your pages, that important content renders in the HTML, and that pages are indexed [3]. Schema markup gives AI systems machine-readable context, and fast, secure pages earn trust signals [2]. Joe's AEO program also covers AI crawler rules, server-rendered content, llms.txt and page speed [4]. For help with this work, see the [contact page](/contact/).
